currentDescriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann das Haber-Bosch-Verfahren analysieren, MWG-Gleichungen mit verschiedenen stöchiometrischen Faktoren anwenden und Gleichgewichtskonzentrationen einschließlich physikalisch zulässiger Lösungen quadratischer Modellgleichungen berechnen.
currentDescriptionEn: The learner can analyze the Haber-Bosch process, apply mass-action equations with different stoichiometric factors, and calculate equilibrium concentrations, including physically admissible solutions of quadratic model equations.

understandingEvidence.essentialUnderstandingDe: Stöchiometrie und physikalischer Konzentrationsbereich bestimmen die MWG-Lösung.
understandingEvidence.essentialUnderstandingEn: Stoichiometry and the physical concentration domain determine a mass-action solution.
understandingEvidence.observablePerformanceDe: Exponenten und Stoffbilanz anwenden; unphysikalische Wurzeln mit negativer Konzentration verwerfen.
understandingEvidence.observablePerformanceEn: Apply exponents and material balance; reject unphysical roots giving negative concentration.
understandingEvidence.transferExpectationDe: Eine umgekehrte Startcharge bilanzieren und trotz Gegenrichtung denselben definierten MWG-Ausdruck verwenden.
understandingEvidence.transferExpectationEn: Balance a reverse initial charge and retain the defined mass-action expression despite reverse conversion.

rationale: Own sealed v2 description KEEP retained after exact whole scientific-goal and neighbouring-context comparison; new normal page/image binding independently checked. The current competence is a mass-action calculation routine in a process context. Haber-Bosch coefficients and process limits are correct; quadratic calculations are expressly model equations, not a claim that every full Haber-Bosch balance is quadratic. q3-07-c supplies full unequal-sum balance, both roots, domain rejection, both concentrations and substitution. Source HE Q3.1 increased-level placement is retained.

currentTitleEn: Determine electrical work of galvanic cells
currentDescriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann die von galvanischen Zellen abgegebene elektrische Arbeit aus Spannungs-, Stromstärke- und Zeitmessungen bestimmen und unter den angegebenen Mess- und Modellbedingungen als umgewandelte chemische Energie einordnen.
currentDescriptionEn: The learner can determine the electrical work delivered by galvanic cells from voltage, current, and time measurements and interpret it as converted chemical energy under the stated measurement and model conditions.

understandingEvidence.essentialUnderstandingDe: Abgegebene elektrische Arbeit hängt von gleichzeitig gemessenen U-, I- und Zeitwerten ab.
understandingEvidence.essentialUnderstandingEn: Delivered electrical work depends on simultaneously measured U, I and time.
understandingEvidence.observablePerformanceDe: Konstante Intervalle summieren und tatsächliche Arbeit von -ΔH sowie reversiblem -ΔG unterscheiden.
understandingEvidence.observablePerformanceEn: Sum constant intervals and distinguish actual work from -ΔH and reversible -ΔG.
understandingEvidence.transferExpectationDe: Leerlaufspannung bei I=0 von abgegebener Energie unterscheiden.
understandingEvidence.transferExpectationEn: Distinguish open-circuit voltage at I=0 from delivered energy.

rationale: Own sealed v2 description KEEP retained after exact whole scientific-goal and neighbouring-context comparison; new normal page/image binding independently checked. Determine-and-interpret delivered work is one measurement-data routine. Simultaneous loaded U/I values, interval constancy and ideal instruments are specified. P=0.120 W, Q=30 C, W=36 J and interval sum 40 J are correct; 45 J from unweighted means is rejected. Open circuit gives zero external work. The new native PNG is independently inspected and correct.

currentTitleDe: Sauerstoff- und Säurekorrosion auf Teilchenebene erklären
currentTitleEn: Explain oxygen and acid corrosion at particle level
currentDescriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann Sauerstoff- und Säurekorrosion auf Teilchenebene mit Oxidation, Reduktion, Lokalelementen und dem Donator-Akzeptor-Konzept erläutern.
currentDescriptionEn: The learner can explain oxygen and acid corrosion at particle level using oxidation, reduction, local cells, and the donor-acceptor concept.

understandingEvidence.essentialUnderstandingDe: Verschiedene Akzeptoren ermöglichen unterschiedliche Korrosion bei gleicher Metalloxidation.
understandingEvidence.essentialUnderstandingEn: Different acceptors permit different corrosion with the same metal oxidation.
understandingEvidence.observablePerformanceDe: Halbgleichungen, lokale Orte und Elektronen-/Ionenwege für beide Umgebungen erklären.
understandingEvidence.observablePerformanceEn: Explain half-equations, local sites and electron/ion paths for both environments.
understandingEvidence.transferExpectationDe: Aus fehlendem Sauerstoff keinen universellen Stopp der sauren Korrosion ableiten.
understandingEvidence.transferExpectationEn: Do not infer universal cessation of acid corrosion from missing oxygen.

rationale: Own sealed v2 description KEEP retained after exact whole scientific-goal and neighbouring-context comparison; new normal page/image binding independently checked. Both environments instantiate one donor-acceptor corrosion explanation. Iron oxidation, neutral oxygen reduction, acidic proton reduction, local cell and transport routes are balanced correctly. Fresh missing-oxygen and disconnected-metal scenarios expose conceptual limits; neither case invents laboratory performance.

currentTitleEn: Evaluate passive and active corrosion protection
currentDescriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann passive und aktive Korrosionsschutzmaßnahmen, insbesondere Beschichtungen, Schutzschichten, galvanische Kopplung und Opferanoden, erläutern und ökologisch sowie ökonomisch bewerten.
currentDescriptionEn: The learner can explain passive and active corrosion protection measures, including coatings, protective layers, galvanic coupling, and sacrificial anodes, and evaluate them ecologically and economically.

understandingEvidence.essentialUnderstandingDe: Schutzwirkung hängt von Barriere oder wirksamer galvanischer Kopplung ab.
understandingEvidence.essentialUnderstandingEn: Protection depends on a barrier or effective galvanic coupling.
understandingEvidence.observablePerformanceDe: Anode/Kathode und Elektronenweg begründen, Verbrauch/Wartung und fehlende Umweltzahlen abwägen.
understandingEvidence.observablePerformanceEn: Explain anode/cathode and electron path; weigh consumption/maintenance and missing environmental data.
understandingEvidence.transferExpectationDe: Elektrisch isoliertes Zn von einer wirksamen Opferanode unterscheiden.
understandingEvidence.transferExpectationEn: Distinguish electrically insulated Zn from an effective sacrificial anode.

rationale: Own sealed v2 description KEEP retained after exact whole scientific-goal and neighbouring-context comparison; new normal page/image binding independently checked. Protection mechanisms support one evidence-based choice. Barriers, Zn sacrificial consumption, harmful Fe/Cu coupling at defects and ecological/economic limits are correct. Consumed or insulated Zn produces valid disconfirming transfer; supplied potentials are used within stated surface-model limits.
